transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. Here's my lab quality analysis finding: My analysis of the spent coolant found 2.4% chlorinated solvent content. Per our site's waste matrix, any batch at or above 1.0% chlorinated solvent must be routed to hazardous-liquid treatment rather than ordinary coolant recycling. Since this batch is at 2.4%, it exceeds the threshold and cannot go to ordinary coolant recycling — it must be sent to hazardous-liquid treatment. This result was completed yesterday but has not yet been attached to the waste authorization, so I want to make sure it's officially on the record as part of this round-robin review before you make the disposal route decision.

I received this permit condition in the contractor's service email but have not yet entered it into the transport booking system, so I'm putting it on the record now as part of this round-robin review so it can be factored into the shipment controls before authorization is issued.
